scientific_limitations: Exact for unweighted undirected K_{2,3}, exactly two initial mutants, constant positive fitness, and death–Birth update. No larger-family, birth–death, or fixation-time claim; priority remains subject to unindexed equivalents.
title: A sharp fitness crossover in two-seed invasion on a five-vertex bipartite population
